access: Drives the owner's real Chromium (via the external OpenCode Browse MCP server + extension the owner installs). Navigation is fenced by the project's site allowlist (.forge/browse.json); acting verbs and hand-back require approval.
description: OpenCode Browse (item #55, adopted — not built): six fenced verbs plus the item #65 verify loop (verify_in_browser) over the owner's signed-in Chromium via its local MCP server. Setup: install Browse with its own installer, add the preset block from the README ('Browse connector') to connectors.json, then enable this connector.
name: Browse (OpenCode)

tools.description: Open a web page in the Browse tab. The host must be on the project's Browse allowlist (.forge/browse.json); unlisted hosts are refused. Only http/https. AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE FIRST: prefer the official docs, the official API reference, or the project's own repository over copies or summaries; if sources disagree, the authoritative one wins.
tools.name: browse_open

tools.description: Read the current Browse page as text. Text is the rule: use browse_screenshot only when text cannot answer.
tools.name: browse_read

tools.description: Click an element on the current Browse page, by CSS selector.
tools.name: browse_click

tools.description: Type text into a field on the current Browse page (CSS selector + the text).
tools.name: browse_type

tools.description: Screenshot the current Browse page. On demand only: page reading is browse_read's text snapshot; screenshot only when text cannot show what you need.
tools.name: browse_screenshot

tools.description: Hand the browser tab to the owner (login, 2FA, payment, captcha, anything needing human hands). Waits at the owner's approval gate with no timeout; approval is their Continue. After a browser wall, Browse stays held and every verb refuses until this is approved.
tools.name: browse_hand_back

reason.description: What the owner is handed and why.

tools.description: Verify your work in the browser: open a page, read it back as text, save a screenshot under .forge/artifacts/ (path returned; the image is never attached). Target: a project-relative page path, served by a throwaway loopback preview exempt from the allowlist (this project's files only, 127.0.0.1, this call only), or an http(s) URL, which must be allowlisted like browse_open. Use after changing a page.
tools.name: verify_in_browser

target.description: Project-relative page path (e.g. 'index.html'), or an allowlisted http(s) URL.
